data.action: 钻进你的伞下紧贴肩膀，星瞳别扭又满足
data.description: 突如其来的夏日骤雨里，女王蜂的白色手提包被她举过头顶挡雨的样子实在称不上优雅。你撑开的伞递过去，她愣了一瞬，随即若无其事地钻进来，肩膀却紧紧贴着你——「哼、本小姐只是给你面子才进来的……伞下三厘米以内，都是本小姐的领域哦。」
data.lighting: 雨幕青灰与街灯暖光交映
data.promptProse: Caught in the summer downpour, Misaki stands on the left in her Tokiwadai uniform, her white handbag lowered and her shoulder pressed against her companion. The companion wears a zipped navy rain shell and holds the umbrella upright, with a dark cropped haircut visible beneath its rim. Warm streetlight reaches their faces through the blue-gray rain.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 雨日共伞的小秘密
data.animaCaption: Misaki, blonde in her Tokiwadai uniform, edges under the umbrella on the left with her handbag lowered. A short-haired companion in a navy rain shell holds the handle on the right.
